Class BehaviorSelector

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.agent.BehaviorSelector
public class BehaviorSelector extends Object
AI brain that selects and executes behaviors based on utility scores. Uses utility-based AI: evaluates all behaviors and picks the highest utility.
